question: Over the period, how do Indonesia and Iran megatonnes relate to each other? (A) Both trend upward together across the period (B) Indonesia trends upward while Iran trends downward (C) They show no consistent relationship, moving independently. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack: line_dual_axis (see that page's meta for the technique and sources) applied to dataset climate_core (Annual CO2 Emissions).
